fix.notes:
The triage sketch pointed at matchups.mustache, but investigation shows the 'matchups' heading referenced in the issue is the

Matchups

in archetype.mustache (the matchup stats section on each archetype page). The fix is a one-line template change. No Python changes needed since /matchups/ is a stable static URL.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong The `

Matchups

` section heading on archetype pages (`/archetype/`) showed matchup statistics for that archetype but provided no navigation path to the full Matchups Calculator at `/matchups/`. Users had no obvious way to reach the calculator from the archetype matchup section. ## What changed In `decksite/templates/archetype.mustache`, the plain `

Matchups

` heading is now `

Matchups

`, turning the heading into a link to the unfiltered Matchups Calculator. ## How it was validated - `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` passed (no database required). - Unit tests were not run due to no database being available in this environment; the change is a one-line template edit with no logic, so the risk is minimal. Fixes #11307

evidence.detail: h1 renders {{page_title}} as plain text — no anchor tag, no href
page_title() returns 'Matchups Calculator' with no link URL provided to template
No link back to /matchups/ anywhere in the template — once a search is active, there is no 'reset' navigation anchor

triage.fix_sketch:
In decksite/templates/matchups.mustache, add a reset link (e.g. `

← All Matchups

`) at the top of the template, or expose `matchups_url = url_for('metagame.matchups')` in decksite/views/matchups.py and render it in the template as a breadcrumb link near the Query section heading.
triage.notes: Purely additive UI change — add a link element; no logic changes needed. The exact placement (banner, top of page, above Query section) is a minor product judgment call but either approach is low-risk.
